user.description: A Hebrew voice assistant that runs entirely on this machine. Nothing goes to the cloud and nothing leaves the house.

data_description.weights_path: Leave empty to use the model that ships with the integration. That is the one every update keeps current.

reconfigure.description: Change which model the assistant loads.

data_description.weights_path: Empty means the bundled model. A path here is never touched by an update, so an old file would keep loading forever.

error.weights_not_found: No file at that path. Home Assistant has to be able to read it, so inside a container use a path under /config.
error.weights_not_cact: That is not a .cact file. `needle build` produces one; a .pkl is the training checkpoint it is built from.
error.weights_missing: The bundled model is not present in this installation, so a path is required. Reinstall the integration, or point this at a .cact file of your own.

abort.already_configured: Needle Assist is already set up.

init.description: Two things the household knows better than a measurement does, and one that is off until you want it.

data.log_utterances: Keep a log of what was said

data_description.music_player: Which Music Assistant speaker plays when the request names no room. Leave empty if you have one player, or if you always say where you want the music.
data_description.max_new_tokens: A tool call is about 25 tokens. Long announcements need more, because Hebrew reaches a tool argument as escape sequences.
data_description.log_utterances: Writes every request to needle_assist/utterances.jsonl under your configuration directory: what it did, how long it took, and the ones refused before the model ran. It stays on this machine, and it is what a Hebrew correction can be measured against.

weights_file_missing.title: Needle Assist cannot find its model file

confirm.description:
The model file this integration was pointed at is no longer there:

`{path}`

Submit to go back to the model that ships with the integration. To use a different file instead, close this and choose **Reconfigure** on the integration.

abort.not_configured: Needle Assist is no longer set up, so there is nothing to repair.
